extraction_notes: The BZT52C9V1 electrical-characteristics row gives VZ minimum 8.65 V, nominal 9.1 V, and maximum 9.56 V at IZT = 5 mA and TA = 25 degC.
The BZT52C9V1 row gives maximum Zener impedance ZZT = 15 ohm at IZT = 5 mA, maximum knee impedance ZZK = 100 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA, and maximum leakage IR = 0.5 uA at VR = 6.0 V, all at TA = 25 degC.
The BZT52C9V1 row gives admissible Zener current IZM = 5 mA and temperature coefficient at IZTC of 3.8 to 7.0 mV/degC.

Maximum ratings include power dissipation PD = 350 mW, forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, storage temperature Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and junction temperature Tj = -55 to +150 degC, all unless otherwise specified at TA = 25 degC.
The nominal VZ table value is represented with source_kind typical because the strict schema has no nominal enum; the nominal semantics are retained in conditions and this note.
The Zener-characteristics curve points are direct approximate digitizations of the labeled 9.1 V curve in p. 3 Fig. 1, converted from the plotted mA axis to A; no points were interpolated.
No numeric capacitance value specific to BZT52C9V1 is tabulated; the p. 3 capacitance plot shows generic family curves without a uniquely identified 9.1 V trace, so capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery-time specification is published in the supplied datasheet, so reverse recovery is null.
The supplied datasheet covers the BZT52C2V0 through BZT52C75 family; the extraction is restricted to the BZT52C9V1 row and its labeled 9.1 V curve.
